open_points.subject: owner-session idle timeout after a failed ordinary form body
open_points.text: “Such a request never arrives in A13 rule 2's sense, since an owner request arrives when it is handed to the session check” contradicts A13 rule 2: “An owner request is any request to the owner interface that carries the valid session, whatever its answer; its arrival restarts the 30 minutes.”
open_points.question: Does an owner-interface form carrying a valid session restart the 30-minute idle period when its body fails before the surface hands it to the session check?
options: It does not restart: arrival means handoff to the session check.
It restarts because it carries a valid session, even though body reading fails before handoff.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the changed State 4 passage as the narrower rule: do not restart the idle period until handoff to the session check.

witness.initial: An owner session is valid, and its last owner request arrived 29 minutes ago.
events: The owner sends an ordinary form with the valid session cookie and accepted framing headers.
The form body fails while the owner surface reads it, before anything is handed to operations or the session check.
Ninety seconds later, the owner sends a complete owner request with the same session.
outcomes: Under State 4, the failed form was no owner request and did not restart the idle period, so the later request is refused because 30 minutes have elapsed.
Under A13 rule 2, the failed form carried the valid session and its arrival restarted the idle period, so the later request is served.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a sign-in refusal or the requested owner-interface answer.
